manuscript_campaign_scope: Recorded N-H, O-H and S-H histories in optimization/current/runs rank the complete 13,920-condition decision space per system.

OH_PL38.catalyst_selection_rule: largest recorded UV response among 145 catalyst entries

candidate_space.role: representative source slices retained for diagnostics

initial_design: archived diagnostic draw of 12 source-slice rows without replacement; manuscript initial batches are recorded in optimization/current/runs
model: model/bo_core.py; standardized 116-dimensional categorical feature kernel; normal–inverse-gamma Bayesian linear regression
acquisition: representative-slice diagnostic: latent posterior mean + 1.96 * latent posterior SD; posterior updated between batches and held constant while selecting each batch of 12
model_input_boundary: only previously selected experimental response labels; no full-pool labels or known optimum supplied to the policy or stop monitor
data_provenance: Original workbook bytes and the complete archived diagnostic exports are retained unchanged; manuscript campaign histories are deposited in optimization/current/runs.
